Oh. That worked.
Hmmm…{{wi}} I think that’s the list of her current equipment. There’s basically nothing.
Good thing I picked up these two limbs, I will equip them later.
“Other modules” means that there are things to equip the bot with other than limbs.
Maybe things like eyes, hair and skin are also modular? It would be cool to experiment a little with this.
I don’t know what this “compatibility” is about, but it looks like everything is alright so let’s better not touch it.
Oh, I know what this is. RAM makes games and internet browsers run better. There’s a lot of it it seems…
Maybe I will take some from the bot and put it in my PC? I need an upgrade to play the newest games.

There is more boring stuff like CPU or BIOS, but I’m not interested in these now. Besides, I don’t know chinese! 
What’s up with the disk though? There’s an error.
I hope it’s not broken, I have no money to spend on parts.
Let’s click on it and see…
